Package Comands

Class Spreadsheet

java.lang.Object
Comands.Spreadsheet
public class Spreadsheet extends Object

The spreadsheet is modelled as a list of rows, each row being a list of Cell objects.

File format

Files are plain-text xml where each line represents a row and commas separate cells.

  • Empty string → EmptyCell
  • Integer literal → IntCell
  • Floating-point literal → DoubleCell
  • Double-quoted text (e.g. "hello") → StringCell
  • Formula starting with = (e.g. =R1C1+R1C2) → FormulaCell

    • setCell

      public String setCell(int row, int column, String content)
      Sets or replaces the cell at the given 1-based row and column.

      If the target row or column does not yet exist, the table is extended with EmptyCell

      Parameters:
      row - the 1-based row
      column - the 1-based column
      content - the new cell content in any format accepted by CellFactory
